svg.title: dsh-power-loss-split split switchboard
svg.desc: One material bus feeds five parallel rule switches; each rule routes to one of two rails — issues[] with found, expected, fix and basis, or skipped[] with its reason. Both rails end in one report view: summary, issueCount, skippedCount, markdown and reportJson.

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Source Han Sans SC',sans-serif

svg.text: One period → five parallel taps → two rails

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Source Han Sans SC',sans-serif

svg.text: Five rules read the same period — no ordering, no short-circuit. A rule that cannot run, or runs with no gap, lands in skipped[] with its reason.
